FOR `p2_6ca163f0` IN `system_auth_records`
    FILTER `p2_6ca163f0`.`_type` == @v_1
    FILTER `p2_6ca163f0`.`realm` == @v_2
    FILTER `p2_6ca163f0`.`token` == @v_3
    LIMIT 0, 1
    RETURN `p2_6ca163f0`

FOR `p2_538aa83f` IN `system_sent_messages`
    FILTER @v_1 IN `p2_538aa83f`.`lookup`.`refs`
    SORT `p2_538aa83f`.`createdAt`.`ts` DESC
    LIMIT 0, 20
    RETURN `p2_538aa83f`
